markscheme.html:
D

The maximum induced emf (ε) is proportional to the number of turns (N) and the speed of the magnet (v), so ε ∝ Nv. A ratio can be set up: ε₂/ε₁ = (N₂v₂)/(N₁v₁). Solving for the new speed v₂ gives v₂ = v₁ * (ε₂/ε₁) * (N₁/N₂) = 2.0 * (300/400) * (100/300) = 0.5 m/s.
